outcome: maximal-to-minimal diastolic flow of uterine arteries
cohort: The study included women with severe postpartum hemorrhage unresponsive to conservative medical treatment who underwent internal iliac artery ligation (n=62) and a control group of women with similar postpartum age, parity, and body mass index who did not have postpartum hemorrhage (n=86).
finding: Internal iliac artery ligation was found to have no significant adverse effect on the sonographic blood flow indexes of the uterine arteries in women with postpartum hemorrhage at 6 months post-procedure.
